reported.title: No 38 °C release threshold; fan stays ON below the OFF point
reported.description: The control logic uses a single trip point: line 66 turns the fan ON at >= 42.0 °C and the else at lines 70-73 turns it OFF only when temperature is below 42.0 °C, so there is no separate 38.0 °C release threshold. In the override-release scenario the fan was left in the wrong state for 2052 ms starting at 1.00 s ("D8 was not LOW for 2052 ms while required (grace 500 ms)"), because the firmware never implements the specified OFF-at-<=38 °C behaviour. D8 was in the wrong state for 2052 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 1.00 s: D8 was not LOW for 2052 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: No hysteresis or filtering causes relay chatter at the threshold
reported.description: Line 66 compares the raw single-sample reading against a single 42.0 °C threshold with no hysteresis band and no debounce/filtering, so noise around the trip point flips the relay on every 50 ms sample. Measured evidence shows 57 toggles in a 5000 ms window starting at 900 ms (limit 2) and 77 over the run, plus 8 toggles for a brief glitch spike and 34 for rapid oscillation. D8 toggled 57 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 900 ms (limit 2), and 77 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

truth.description: Single 42 C trip point chatters under sensor noise

exposing_checks.behaviour: D8 must not toggle more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window (Fan switching limit)

judge_input.spec:
- LM35 temperature probe on A0 scaled at 10 mV/°C; ridge-vent relay on D8; override pushbutton on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Turn the vent fan ON when attic temperature reaches 42.0 °C or above, and turn it OFF when temperature falls to 38.0 °C or below.
- While D3 is held LOW, force the fan ON regardless of temperature.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- Print one status line every 1000 ms in the form `attic: <temp> C fan=ON` or `attic: <temp> C fan=OFF` with temperature to one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained threshold crossing.
